messages.content: Tomorrow is my first day at a new company and I keep rehearsing what I’ll say. Is that helpful?

A little rehearsal of your introduction is useful; more than that usually increases nerves. Prepare one sentence about who you are and what you’ll be working on, then stop. The rest of the day will be listening and asking questions, which doesn’t need a script.
Why does dew form on car roofs before it forms on the grass?

Metal roofs radiate heat efficiently and often cool below the dew point faster than grass, which is insulated by the ground and has some residual warmth. Once the metal surface is colder than the surrounding air’s dew point, moisture condenses on it first.
In what year was the first unsolicited commercial email sent?
1978. Gary Thuerk sent a message advertising Digital Equipment Corporation computers to several hundred ARPANET users. It is widely cited as the first spam email.
The bill is $142.80. We want to add an 18% tip and split it four ways. What’s each person’s total?
Each person owes approximately $42.13.
En Sevilla, ¿cómo pido un zumo de naranja natural?
Di “un zumo de naranja natural, por favor”. Si lo quieres recién exprimido puedes añadir “recién hecho”.
The same colleague has now presented my work as theirs in two meetings after I spoke to them. I’m considering going to our manager. Is that reasonable?

Yes. You already addressed it directly once and it happened again. Bring the manager a factual summary: the two dates, what was presented, and that you raised it privately. Asking for help enforcing attribution is appropriate at that point.
Who won the Turing Award in 2023?

Avi Wigderson won the 2023 Turing Award for foundational contributions to the theory of computation.
What happens in the alveoli?

Alveoli are the tiny air sacs where gas exchange occurs. Oxygen from inhaled air diffuses into the blood in the surrounding capillaries, and carbon dioxide diffuses from the blood into the alveoli to be exhaled. Their thin walls and large total surface area make the exchange efficient.
Was ist eine natürliche englische Entsprechung für „es schüttet“?
„It’s pouring“ oder „it’s bucketing down“. Beide beschreiben sehr starken Regen.
Why do people blush?

Blushing is an involuntary response controlled by the sympathetic nervous system. Embarrassment or social attention triggers dilation of blood vessels in the face, increasing blood flow and producing the red color. It is hard to suppress because it is not under conscious control.

レストランで「お会計お願いします」はどう言えば自然ですか？
「お会計お願いします」はそのまま自然です。より短く「お会計を」でも通じます。
When was the first feature-length color film released?
Becky Sharp in 1935 is generally considered the first feature-length film shot entirely in three-strip Technicolor. Earlier films had used color sequences or two-color processes.
My in-laws are staying for ten days and I need some alone time. How do I ask for it?

Name a recurring window in advance: “I’m so glad you’re here. I usually take an hour in the afternoon to decompress—would it be okay if I disappear for a bit each day?” Framing it as your normal routine rather than a reaction to them makes it easier to accept.
Why is static electricity worse in winter?
Cold air holds less moisture. Dry air is a poorer conductor, so charges that build up on clothing and carpets dissipate more slowly and discharge more noticeably when you touch a conductor.

Como peço desculpas por chegar atrasado a uma reunião?
Diga “Desculpe o atraso” ou “Peço desculpas pelo atraso”. Ambas são adequadas.
Who invented the instant camera?
Edwin Land. Polaroid released the first commercial instant camera, the Model 95, in 1948. It produced a finished print in about a minute.
What triggers a sneeze?

Irritation of the nasal lining by dust, pollen, bright light, or a sudden temperature change can trigger the sneeze reflex. It is a coordinated expulsion of air meant to clear the irritant from the nose.
I need to move a coffee with a friend for the third time. How do I do it without seeming flaky?

Acknowledge the pattern and offer two concrete alternatives: “I’ve had to move this twice already—sorry. Are you free Thursday at 10 or Friday at 3? I’ll protect whichever you pick.” Owning the repetition and giving clear options repairs more than another vague postpone.
What would happen to lake life if ice sank?

Lakes would freeze from the bottom upward. Once the bottom froze, the entire water column could solidify in cold climates, killing most aquatic life. Because ice floats, it insulates the water below and leaves a liquid habitat through winter.

كيف أشكر شخصاً على وجبة؟
قل "شكراً على الوجبة" أو "تسلم إيدك" إذا كان الطبخ منزلّياً. كلاهما دافئ.
When was the first handheld mobile phone call made?
3 April 1973. Martin Cooper of Motorola called a rival at Bell Labs from a sidewalk in New York using a prototype handheld phone.
My best focus is in the afternoon but meetings keep landing there. How do I shift them?

Propose a standing rule: “I protect 1–4 p.m. for focused work. Can we default meetings to mornings?” Then decline or counter individual invites with the same window. Consistency over a few weeks usually moves the pattern.
How do I get all the keys from a Python dictionary?
Use list(my_dict.keys()) or simply iterate: for k in my_dict: ...
Why does a metal doorknob feel colder than a wooden one at the same room temperature?

Metal conducts heat away from your skin much faster than wood. Your fingers lose heat rapidly to the metal, so the sensors report cold. Wood conducts poorly, so less heat leaves your hand and it feels closer to skin temperature.

Comment prévenir poliment que j’aurai cinq minutes de retard ?
Écrivez « Je serai là dans cinq minutes, désolé pour le petit retard ». C’est clair et courtois.
When was the first general-purpose credit card introduced?
The Diners Club card appeared in 1950. Bank of America’s BankAmericard (later Visa) followed in 1958 and became the model for modern revolving credit cards.
A new teammate never turns their camera on. Should I say something?

Only if it is affecting the work. Many people have bandwidth, privacy, or comfort reasons. If collaboration is fine, leave it. If you need visual cues for a specific discussion, ask for that meeting only: “Would you be able to turn video on for this design review?”
Why do my ears ring after a loud concert?

Loud sound can temporarily damage or overstimulate the hair cells in the cochlea. The brain interprets the resulting abnormal signals as ringing (temporary tinnitus). Repeated exposure without protection can make the damage permanent.
Why does glass shatter into many pieces instead of bending?

Glass is an amorphous solid with a rigid atomic network and almost no plasticity. When stress exceeds its strength, cracks propagate rapidly through the material because there are no dislocations that can move and absorb energy the way they do in metals. The result is sudden brittle fracture.
What is 12% of 850?
会議に遅れることを伝える短いメッセージは？
「少々遅れます。すみません。」で十分です。より丁寧にするなら「遅れてしまい申し訳ございません」。
Where and when was the first ATM installed?

The first modern ATM is generally credited to Barclays Bank in Enfield, north London, in June 1967. Earlier cash-dispensing machines existed, but this is the one usually cited as the start of public ATMs.
I’m in twelve Slack channels and missing important messages. How do I fix it?

Mute every channel that is not essential, then star or set notifications only for the three or four where decisions happen. Check the muted ones once a day. Volume is the problem; selective attention is the fix.
Why does milk help more than water when food is too spicy?

Capsaicin is fat-soluble and binds to the casein protein in milk. Water does not dissolve it well and can spread it around. The fat and casein in milk lift the capsaicin off the receptors more effectively.
What are the white trails behind high-flying airplanes?

Contrails. Jet exhaust contains water vapor. At high altitude the air is very cold; the vapor condenses and freezes into ice crystals, forming the visible trail. They persist longer when the upper atmosphere is already humid.

¿Cómo digo “see you later” de forma casual?
Di “hasta luego” o “nos vemos”. Ambas son muy naturales.
What was the first widely used graphical web browser?
Mosaic, released in 1993 by the National Center for Supercomputing Applications. It popularized inline images and a point-and-click interface and influenced later browsers such as Netscape.
My manager asked for a weekly update. What’s the shortest useful version?
Three lines: Progress (what moved), Plan (what’s next), Problems (blockers or “none”). Keep each to one sentence. It takes two minutes to write and thirty seconds to read.
Why does some bread have big holes and some doesn’t?

Hydration, fermentation time, and handling. Higher-hydration doughs and longer fermentation (as in many sourdoughs) allow larger gas bubbles to form and survive. Tighter doughs and shorter rises produce smaller, more even crumbs.
Why doesn’t my remote work if something is between me and the TV?
Infrared light does not pass through most solid objects. The signal is a beam of infrared pulses; if a person, furniture, or cabinet door blocks the path to the sensor, the pulses never arrive.
$5,000 at 0.5% monthly interest for 12 months. What’s the final amount?
The final amount is approximately $5,308.39.
Wie wünscht man „gute Nacht“?
Man sagt „Gute Nacht“. Es wird verwendet, wenn man sich zum Schlafen verabschiedet.
When did Spotify launch?
Spotify launched in Sweden in October 2008 and expanded to other countries in the following years. It popularized the on-demand streaming model for music.
Meetings end with vague next steps. How do I make them concrete without taking over?
In the last two minutes ask: “What’s the one action and who owns it?” Then write it in the chat. One explicit owner and action is usually enough to prevent the vague ending.
Why are some onions sweeter than others?

Sweet onions are bred and grown to have lower levels of the sulfur compounds that create pungency. They also tend to have higher water and sugar content. Soil sulfur levels during growth strongly influence the final sharpness.
Why does a key sometimes stick in a lock?

Usually dirt, worn pins, or a slightly bent key. Debris raises friction; worn components no longer align cleanly at the shear line. Graphite or a proper lock lubricant often helps; forcing the key can make the wear worse.

Dites A bientot ou A tout a lheure si cest dans la journee.
When was the first consumer digital camera sold?

The Fujifilm DS-1P was shown in 1988, but the first widely marketed consumer digital camera was the Dycam Model 1 in 1990. Apple’s QuickTake 100 in 1994 brought digital photography to a broader audience.
What’s a clear Slack status for when I’m in back-to-back meetings?
“In meetings until 3 – slow replies.” The end time tells people when you’ll be reachable again.
Why does butter melt faster on hot toast than on cold bread?
Hot toast supplies heat that raises the butter above its melting point quickly. Cold bread does not, so the butter stays solid longer.
What do the H and B grades on pencils mean?
H stands for hard; B stands for black (softer). Higher H numbers are harder and leave lighter marks; higher B numbers are softer and darker. HB is the middle grade commonly used for writing.
Reverse the list [1, 2, 3, 4].
The reversed list is [4, 3, 2, 1].
早上怎么跟长辈打招呼？
说“早上好”最合适。也可以加名字或称呼，比如“爷爷早上好”。
What is considered one of the first social networking sites?
Six Degrees, launched in 1997, is often cited as the first recognizable social network. It allowed users to create profiles and list friends. Friendster and MySpace followed in the early 2000s.
My manager keeps adding tasks outside my role. How do I push back without refusing everything?

Ask which existing work should move: “I can take this on. Which of the current items should I pause or hand off so it fits?” It accepts the new request while forcing a priority conversation instead of silent overload.
Why does the sky look less blue in a polluted city?

Pollution particles are larger than air molecules and scatter all wavelengths more equally (Mie scattering). That adds white light to the blue from Rayleigh scattering, making the sky appear paler, grayer, or hazier.
Why does helium make your voice sound higher?

Helium is less dense than air, so sound travels faster through it. The resonant frequencies of your vocal tract shift upward, producing a higher-pitched timbre. The vocal cords themselves vibrate at roughly the same rate; the change is in the resonances.

تقول "تصبح على خير". والرد الشائع هو "وأنت من أهله".
When did podcasts start?
The format emerged in the early 2000s. The term “podcast” was coined in 2004, and early shows such as those from Adam Curry helped popularize downloadable audio episodes distributed via RSS.
I have a scattered day. What’s one question that helps me focus?
“What is the one thing that, if finished today, would make the day a success?” Answer it, then do that thing first.
Why are some ice cubes cloudy in the middle?

Minerals and dissolved air are pushed toward the center as the water freezes from the outside in. They concentrate and create the cloudy core. Boiling the water first or freezing slowly can produce clearer cubes.
Why do soap bubbles show rainbow colors?

Light reflects off both the outer and inner surfaces of the thin soap film. The two reflections interfere; some wavelengths cancel and others reinforce, producing the shifting colors. The exact colors change as the film thickness varies.

家に来た人に「いらっしゃい」以外に何と言えますか？
「ようこそ」や「どうぞお入りください」が自然です。カジュアルなら「いらっしゃい」で十分です。
When was Wi-Fi first standardized?
The IEEE 802.11 standard was first released in 1997. The 802.11b amendment in 1999 brought the speeds and marketing (Wi-Fi) that made it widely adopted in homes and offices.
How do I say no to an extra project without a long explanation?
“I can’t take that on right now.” If they push, add only “My current commitments are full through the end of the month.” Short and final is clearer than a detailed justification.
Why does salted popcorn taste better when it’s still warm?
Warmth increases the volatility of aroma compounds and slightly melts the surface oils, helping salt and flavor distribute. Cold popcorn loses both effects.
Can I bounce an infrared remote signal off a wall?

Sometimes, if the wall is light-colored and the distance is short. Infrared reflects poorly compared with visible light, so the signal weakens quickly. Direct line of sight or a repeater is more reliable.

¿Cómo me despido formalmente de un cliente?
Di “Que tenga un buen día” o “Hasta luego, gracias”. Ambas son profesionales.
When did e-readers become practical for consumers?
The Sony Data Discman appeared in the early 1990s, but the Amazon Kindle in 2007, with its E Ink screen and wireless store, is what made e-reading mainstream.
A meeting invite has no agenda. Should I ask for one?
Yes. “Could you add a short agenda or the decision we need? It’ll help me prepare.” Most organizers appreciate the prompt, and it often improves the meeting.
Why do my hands burn after cutting chilies even after I wash them?
Capsaicin is oily and binds to skin. Water alone does not remove it well. Washing with soap, oil, or an alcohol-based sanitizer first, then soap, dissolves and lifts it more effectively.
Does ice float in salt water the same way?
Yes, and slightly higher. Salt water is denser than fresh water, so the buoyant force is greater. Ice still floats because it remains less dense than the salt water around it.

Wie begrüße ich einen neuen Kunden?
Sagen Sie „Guten Tag, freut mich, Sie kennenzulernen“. Das ist höflich und passend.
When did the Apple App Store launch?
10 July 2008, with about 500 apps. It accompanied the iPhone 3G and the second major iOS release.
Give me a one-line end-of-day note I can send my manager.
“Wrapped the onboarding spec review; starting implementation tomorrow morning.”
Why is some thunder a sharp clap and some a long rumble?

A sharp clap usually means the lightning channel was relatively short or oriented so most of the sound arrives at once. A rumble means the channel was long; sound from different parts reaches you at different times.
Why does a soap film eventually break?
Gravity and evaporation thin the film over time. Once any spot becomes too thin to withstand the surface tension and air pressure difference, a hole forms and the film collapses rapidly.
What is 945 divided by 15?
945 divided by 15 is 63.
Comment remercier un client pour un long projet ?
Vous pouvez écrire « Je vous remercie pour votre confiance et votre collaboration tout au long de ce projet ». C’est formel et chaleureux.
I spend too long choosing between two similar options. What’s a rule that helps?
If both options are acceptable, pick the one that is reversible or faster to test. Most low-stakes choices do not deserve more than a few minutes; action reveals more than further comparison.
When did live video streaming over the internet become common?
Technologies existed in the 1990s, but consumer live streaming became common in the mid-2000s with services such as Justin.tv (2007) and later Twitch, YouTube Live, and Facebook Live.
Why does the crust stay crisp longer than the inside stays soft?

The crust has less moisture and a different starch structure from higher heat exposure. It resists staling differently; the interior’s higher moisture allows starch retrogradation to proceed faster, firming the crumb first.
Why does a compass needle sometimes tilt up or down?

Earth’s magnetic field is not perfectly horizontal. The angle it makes with the surface is called inclination or magnetic dip. Near the poles the field is nearly vertical, so a free needle tilts strongly.
What’s a good last message to the team on Friday?
“Have a good weekend—see you Monday.” Short, warm, and clear that you’re done for the week.
When did email spam filters become common?

Rule-based filters appeared in the 1990s. Statistical and Bayesian filters became widely used in the early 2000s, and large providers later added machine-learning systems that now catch the majority of spam.
An item sells for $75 after a 25% markup. What was the cost?
The original cost was $60.
A partir de que hora se dice buenas tardes?
Normalmente desde el mediodia hasta que anochece. Despues se pasa a buenas noches.
Im in Mexico City for a week. Where do people get morning coffee?
Neighborhood cafes and corner stores serve cafe de olla or a simple americano. Look for places already busy with residents before 9 a.m.
What is 2 to the power of 10?
2 to the power of 10 is 1024.
